text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You're trying to get Suzuka-kun more 
involved in summer camp? 
Ha-ha-ha! What a bizarre validation 
experiment!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Loving freedom and solitude is who 
Suzuka-kun is, and that is her virtue. 
Forcing someone to do what goes against 
their very nature is ill-advised to begin 
with."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You don't seem like the pushy type 
either... 
—Which means, I'd love to know the true 
essence behind your motives."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, the day will come when 
everyone must leave this academy."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"When moving on to the next chapter of our 
lives... 
how much of these days will we truly be 
able to remember?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...When we eventually part and forget 
most of our life here—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that what suddenly comes to 
mind... 
will surely be nothing more than a single 
grain of gold resting at the bottom of our 
hearts."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...A single grain... of gold..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"One can live perfectly fine without it. 
Yet, the moment you realize it is missing 
and yearn for it, it cannot be regained."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I do not want her 
to lose it now. 
...You may tell me it makes no sense. But 
that is my only reason."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Hey Tachyon, say something."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Ah, so you want her to attain *that*."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see! I see, I see! 
Ha-ha-ha! How fascinating! My curiosity is 
thoroughly piqued!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I had presumed the merits of prolonged 
communal lodging lay primarily in standard 
educational effects, coupled with an 
increase in post-autumn vitality via 
reward-system stimulation—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—but what if that isn't all?! Dopamine 
release in the nucleus accumbens connects 
with the hippocampus; pleasurable emotions 
stored as long-term memories are... mm, 
yes!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"My word, what an unexpected realization! 
Very well, I shall assist you with this 
endeavor!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Um... may I join in as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Alright, count me in too!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You all... No, wait, hold on. 
I appreciate the help, but as of right 
now, I have no concrete plan."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"No sweat, no sweat! Basically, all we 
gotta do is make sure Suzuka gets one big, 
unforgettable fun memory, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That may be true, but we must take it 
step by step. 
We should start by letting Suzuka get used 
to this lifestyle—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, you're way too overprotective 
when it comes to Suzuka! 
—For now, just leave it to us!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Is this the place Pokke mentioned?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still... what lovely weather... 
Running with all my might under skies like 
this would feel so wonderful..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Yo, Suzu-ka~♪"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Pokke...? And, um... 
who are all the people behind you...?"

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Pal A
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright! Pokke-san, this is the 
target Umamusume, right?! 
—We don't need to hold back, do we...?!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Target...? Hold back...? Um, what are you 
talking about?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Heh, isn't it obvious?! —Take this!"
"(SPLASH!! SPLASH!!)"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "AHAHAHA! Nice, clean hit!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Today's our day off, right? 
Let's have a massive water gun brawl! I 
even rounded up a whole bunch of people!"

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Pal A
text_block_list.text:
"Here, this water gun is for you, 
Suzuka-san!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Th-Thank you... Wait, no! Why so 
suddenly...! 
Besides, I haven't played with a water gun 
since I was a little kid—"
(SPLASH, SPLASH!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry 'bout it, just come on♪ If 
you keep spacing out, you're gonna take 
another one to the face! 
And with that—start!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that being a bit too pushy!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, she's likely provoking her on 
purpose. 
Besides, Suzuka-kun isn't so fragile. Just 
watch."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait a second...! 
What's going on... What is the meaning of 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Then if you can catch up and hit me 
even once, 
I'll explain everything. In short... let's 
make this a speed contest!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Speed...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I won't force ya if you're gonna chicken 
out, though.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...A speed contest, is it? In that 
case...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's the spirit! —Alright guys, war 
has begun!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *pant*, *pant*! 
Ngh... Just a little more... and I'll 
reach! —Hah!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gah-bwah!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Why you, not bad at all, Suzukaaa! 
Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, now then, tell me why, will you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"No big reason? Just thought I wanted to 
mess around with you for real. 
You don't really do stuff like this, 
right? Usually, that is."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, since I took a direct hit... 
Hey! The rest of you, 
get in on this already! Tachyon, Cafe, Air 
Groove!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you all seem to be having quite a 
lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh? Since when were you here...!?"
